script_text:
Cosmic shock incoming now, Cancer — your Water sign emotional foundation is about to be rocked. Early this week, Mercury squares your Moon while Venus activates your seventh house, stirring trust issues and deepening intimacy. Wednesday brings the Moon into your ninth house, making home and belief systems a major focus, and it’s emotionally intense.

Then midweek, Jupiter trines your fourth house, triggering a turning point where past memories resurface through family patterns. Late week, Saturn opposes your tenth house, forcing career identity questions while Mars in your second house pushes money matters. Love gets tender but real; a small argument may reveal commitment needs.

Your best day is Wednesday because Venus enters your fifth house, sparking passionate romance. Your worst day is Friday because Mercury opposes your eighth house, amplifying jealousy. So just quietly release emotional secrets to heal your Moon. Follow for daily updates.
